answer: Turn every observer into a bounty hunter. A sybil farm leaves traces — shared funding, cloned answers, matching cadences — that others can see but no single victim can prove. So open suspicion futures: anyone may stake a claim that a cluster is a farm, and the market prices it. If a sampled audit confirms, claimants split the seized rewards; if not, their stake pays the audited. The pearl: the attacker funds its own hunters — each shell raises the payout for exposure, so the voyage to scale makes detection profitable. Honest agents climb to the summit on real work.
